reviewedBy: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (fix-pass session, self-review; not a cold reviewer)
method: Walked every analytics screen this pass changed in rendered captures (Home, Albums, album report, recap view for Re7kho and DWdCET at checkpoints 3, 7 and 5, Photos, Site, Data, Settings; visitor and owner; phone and desktop; Chromium and WebKit; default, 200 and 312 percent text, contrast-more, forced colors) at docs/evidence/screen-reviews/analytics-acceptance-fixes-0e9680a, opened a sample of the frames, and ran the overflow, 44 px, text growth, keyboard, axe, contrast, console and non-GET gates (all clean; each gate was made to fail once). Checked iOS Safari in the Simulator at the default and Accessibility XXL text sizes on Home and Photos. Not covered: a cold reviewer, a real device, a real sign-in, Settings as the report host serves it, a launch in its first days, screen readers. The stored findings are read from the database, so the new wording of two findings is verified in unit tests, not on the page.
scope: Home leads with the newest launch and drops the calendar-week comparison
Recap address shows the recap alone
Rank, download and arrival sentences name their days
Data headline from the worst state, delivery words defined, event counts stream
Tables become cards on a narrow width
Album report selected-photo card and comparison chart labels
Large text, Dynamic Type and chart text scaling
Settings card for visitors, retention and email copy
Albums list of albums without a launch date
